description.en:
Starts an in-match scene. It does nothing outside a match (CMND_IS_SOCCER_ACTIVE). Otherwise it switches the match into event mode (CMND_BTL_SET_ACTIVE_EVENT(1, _is_upper)) and waits until the switch is done (CMND_BTL_IS_FINISH_ACTEV).
When the scene uses the top screen, it also stores the map and Special Move map handles in aHdl[0] and aHdl[1], shows the Special Move map in place of the normal map, and loads the goal model data/chr/option/goal01.xc into aHdl[2] (with a shadow if _shadow is true).
EndScEvent undoes all of this.
Non-zero when the scene uses the top screen (the events pass their isEvUpperDisp variable, usually 1).
3-element array the function fills with handles (map, Special Move map, goal model) and that EndScEvent reads back; the events pass their scEvHdl array.
true to create the goal model with a shadow (StartScEvent_Shadow).

examples.case: Start and end of an in-match scene (real usage, from ev44010020.nut)
